name: Volumetric Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling
definition: A rendering algorithm that samples the distance to the next scattering event or surface intersection using the transmittance distribution, handling both volume scattering and surface emission.
summary: Volumetric Path Tracing with Transmittance Sampling is a rendering algorithm that samples interaction distances from the transmittance distribution to handle volume scattering and surface emission, differing from standard volumetric path tracing by using explicit distance sampling instead of delta tracking.
